title: Phản ánh tín hiệu
vision_description: The lecture page titled 'Phản ánh tín hiệu' discusses signal reflection. It includes text, formulas, and diagrams illustrating continuous and discrete signal reflection.
main_message: Signal reflection involves reversing the time variable in a signal to obtain its reflected version.

definitions.definition: A process where a signal is reflected by reversing its time variable.

charts.description: Two diagrams showing continuous and discrete signal reflection. The continuous signal is labeled X(-t) and X(t), while the discrete signal is labeled X(n) and (-n)X.

bilingual_aliases: Phản ánh tín hiệu: Signal reflection
